proposals.reason: First harmonised AI Act standard formally cited in Official Journal, conferring presumption of conformity for Article 17 QMS requirements.

card.t: EN 18286:2026 — First Harmonised AI Act Standard
card.x: Commission Decision (EU) 2026/2274 formally cites EN 18286:2026 (QMS for high-risk AI providers) in OJ, conferring presumption of conformity under Article 17 AI Act.

proposals.reason: New revision clarifies interpretation of IVDR classification rules for control materials, affecting classification decisions and technical documentation.

card.x: Updated interpretation grid for in vitro diagnostic control material classification under Regulation (EU) 2017/746, harmonising approach across Member States.

card.x: Final vote on AI traceability requirements (Part 1 of 5-part trustworthiness framework) supporting Article 12 AI Act. Publication expected Q1 2027 if approved.

proposals.reason: Public enquiry deadline for human oversight standard supporting Article 14 AI Act, with formal vote scheduled July 2027.

card.x: Public consultation deadline for AI human oversight standard (Part 3 of trustworthiness framework) supporting Article 14 AI Act. Vote scheduled 1 July 2027.

card.t: prEN 18283 — AI Bias Management Enquiry Closes
card.x: Public consultation deadline for AI bias management standard supporting Annex IV AI Act requirements. Vote scheduled 3 March 2027.

proposals.reason: Complete three-part identity management framework published, requiring audit of patient identity systems for HDS and EHDS compliance.

proposals.reason: Major revision of biocompatibility standard published with new test methods and evaluation criteria affecting biological risk assessment for all device classes.

card.x: Major revision covering genetic, carcinogenic, and reproductive/developmental toxicity testing with new methods and evaluation criteria. Transition timeline to be confirmed by notified bodies.

proposals.reason: EUR 500k sanction for inadequate technical and organisational measures protecting patient data establishes enforcement precedent under GDPR Article 32.

card.x: Hôpital privé de la Loire sanctioned for insufficient security measures (GDPR Art. 32) after breach affecting ~500,000 patients. Decision published 16 Oct 2026.

proposals.reason: MHRA unveils 2030 strategy establishing AI & Digital Health Centre and adaptive regulatory framework for AI-based medical devices.

card.t: UK MHRA — 2030 Strategy for AI & Digital Health
card.x: Three pillars: AI & Digital Health Centre, adaptive regulatory framework for AI devices, and expanded Pre-determined Change Control Plans (PCCP) for AI. International harmonisation focus.

card.t: Australia TGA — CDSS Classification Rules In Force
